call_points.text: Management said FY27 EBITDA margin can improve over FY26, when asked to confirm the assumption.
Reiterated the ₹4,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr profit milestone by 2028.
R&D budget for this year guided at ₹180-200 Cr, up from ₹160 Cr last year.
Destiny deals crossed 100 for the first time, with seven converted in the quarter.
Purple Fabric cumulative spend is over ₹700-800 Cr over eight years, about ₹100 Cr a year.
Purple Fabric will remain a separate line of business; management said there are no demerger plans.
Management acknowledged clients building software in-house with AI is a trend, but expects most to return to vendors.
Purple Fabric internal pilot shows potential to cut development effort by 60%, which management flagged as a risk for IT services.
